up: Find all compounds reported in document CHEMBL1156824. Return the following columns: compound_chembl_id, pref_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Join the document table (docs) with compound records, molecule dictionary, and compound structures to link the document to the compounds. Sort the results by compound_chembl_id in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1156824' ORDER BY compound_chembl_id ASC
